group:paper-gaokao-2022-i:reading-b.overview: 作者从自家芝麻菜放坏的经历说起，指出食物浪费既有违道德，又浪费资源、加剧温室气体排放；接着介绍柯廷的机构回收食物做成餐食，最后转述他的建议：人人都能减少浪费。
group:paper-gaokao-2022-i:reading-b.fullTranslationZh:
和我们大多数人一样，我尽量留意不浪费食物。那些芝麻菜本来要做一份不错的蔬菜沙拉，给烤鸡晚餐配个菜。可我最后加班到很晚。接着朋友又打电话请我吃晚饭。我把鸡塞进了冷冻室。可几天过去，芝麻菜坏了。更糟的是，我当初不假思索地买得太多了；扔掉的那些足够做六份沙拉。

在一个每年有近8亿人挨饿的世界里，正如伊丽莎白·罗伊特在本月封面故事中所写，“浪费食物有违道德”。大量完好的食物被扔掉，多得令人瞠目——从被食品杂货商拒收的“难看”（但完全能吃）的蔬菜，到被倒进餐馆垃圾桶的大量剩菜。

生产没人吃的食物，白白浪费了种植它所用的水、燃料和其他资源。这使食物浪费成为一个环境问题。事实上，罗伊特写道：“如果食物浪费是一个国家，它将是世界第三大温室气体排放国。”

如果这不好理解，那就把它简化成我冰箱深处那些芝麻菜那样简单的事。迈克·柯廷常常见到我这种芝麻菜的故事——只不过对他来说，更像是12箱快要放坏的捐赠草莓。柯廷是华盛顿特区“DC中央厨房”的首席执行官，这家机构回收食物，把它们做成健康的餐食。去年，它通过接受捐赠、收集那些否则就会烂在地里的有瑕疵的农产品，回收了超过807,500磅食物。那些草莓呢？志愿者会把它们洗净、切好，冷冻或晾干，留着以后做餐食用。

这些办法看似显而易见，可我们常常就是想不到。“每个人都能为减少浪费出一份力，无论是每周采购时不买超出需要的食物，还是请餐馆不要上你不吃的配菜，”柯廷说。

selectedLongSentences.sourceText: Last year it recovered more than 807,500 pounds of food by taking donations and collecting blemished (有瑕疵的) produce that otherwise would have rotted in fields.
selectedLongSentences.displayText: Last year it recovered more than 807,500 pounds of food by taking donations and collecting blemished (有瑕疵的) produce that otherwise would have rotted in fields.
selectedLongSentences.translationZh: 去年，它通过接受捐赠、收集那些否则就会烂在地里的有瑕疵的农产品，回收了超过807,500磅食物。
selectedLongSentences.analysisZh: 主干是 it recovered more than 807,500 pounds of food：它回收了八十多万磅食物，it 指 DC Central Kitchen。by 后面两个动名词 taking donations 和 collecting blemished produce 由 and 并列，说回收靠什么办法。that otherwise would have rotted in fields 是定语从句，修饰 produce；otherwise 意为“要不是被收走”，would have rotted 是虚拟语气，说这些农产品本来会烂在地里。第26题“没人要的食物”就落在这里。

that otherwise would have rotted in fields

selectedLongSentences.sourceText: Everyone can play a part in reducing waste, whether by not purchasing more food than necessary in your weekly shopping or by asking restaurants to not include the side dish you won’t eat
selectedLongSentences.displayText: Everyone can play a part in reducing waste, whether by not purchasing more food than necessary in your weekly shopping or by asking restaurants to not include the side dish you won’t eat
selectedLongSentences.translationZh: 每个人都能为减少浪费出一份力，无论是每周采购时不买超出需要的食物，还是请餐馆不要上你不吃的配菜
selectedLongSentences.analysisZh: 主干是 Everyone can play a part in reducing waste：人人都能为减少浪费出力。后面 whether by … or by … 给出两种做法，两个 by 后各接一个动名词短语：not purchasing more food than necessary（不买超出需要的食物）和 asking restaurants to not include the side dish（请餐馆别上配菜）。than necessary 是 than is necessary 的省略；you won’t eat 是省略关系词的定语从句，修饰 side dish。第27题要的就是第一个 by 后的做法。

discourseStructure.summary: 先讲作者自己因一时疏忽让芝麻菜坏掉的小事，引出食物浪费的话题；再借罗伊特的文章说明浪费有违道德、危害环境；接着以柯廷的机构为例，说明回收食物的做法；最后转述柯廷的建议，号召人人减少浪费。

paragraphs.summary: 作者本想节约，却因加班赴约、又买得太多，让芝麻菜坏掉扔了
paragraphs.function: 用亲身经历引出话题：人会不经意地浪费食物。

paragraphs.function: 进一步说明浪费食物危害环境。

paragraphs.summary: 柯廷的机构回收捐赠和有瑕疵的食物，做成健康餐食
paragraphs.function: 举实例说明怎样减少食物浪费。

paragraphs.summary: 柯廷建议：别多买，别点不吃的配菜
paragraphs.function: 收尾，给出人人可做的减少浪费的办法。

question:paper-gaokao-2022-i:24.questionFocus: 读完作者芝麻菜放坏的经过，看这段亲身经历要说明什么。
question:paper-gaokao-2022-i:24.stemTranslationZh: 作者讲芝麻菜的故事想说明什么？
question:paper-gaokao-2022-i:24.locateFindZh: 往后读完这件事，看作者的反省

optionAnalysis.label: A
optionAnalysis.optionTranslationZh: 我们很少关注食物浪费。

trap.sourceQuote: Like most of us, I try to be mindful of food that goes to waste.
trap.optionText: We pay little attention to food waste.
trap.explanation: 作者一开头就说自己和大多数人一样，尽量留意别浪费（try to be mindful）；这次浪费是一时疏忽，不是平时不在意。

trapEvidence.quote: Like most of us, I try to be mindful of food that goes to waste.

optionAnalysis.label: B
optionAnalysis.optionTranslationZh: 我们有时会无意中浪费食物。

evidence.quote: Even worse, I had unthinkingly bought way too much; I could have made six salads with what I threw out.
Like most of us, I try to be mindful of food that goes to waste.

optionAnalysis.label: C
optionAnalysis.optionTranslationZh: 我们浪费的蔬菜比肉多。

trap.claim: We waste more vegetables than meat.
trap.explanation: 故事里坏掉的是芝麻菜，鸡肉放进了冷冻室（freezer），这只是作者一次的经历；原文没比较人们浪费蔬菜和肉哪个多。

optionAnalysis.label: D
optionAnalysis.optionTranslationZh: 我们浪费食物是有正当理由的。

trap.sourceQuote: Even worse, I had unthinkingly bought way too much; I could have made six salads with what I threw out.
trap.optionText: We have good reasons for wasting food.
trap.explanation: 加班、朋友邀约只是菜放坏的经过；作者接着用“更糟的是”（Even worse）检讨自己不假思索买太多，并不认为浪费有理。

trapEvidence.quote: Even worse, I had unthinkingly bought way too much; I could have made six salads with what I threw out.

locationParaphrases.targetText: The arugula (芝麻菜)was to make a nice green salad, rounding out a roast chicken dinner.
locationParaphrases.answerText: I had unthinkingly bought way too much
locationParaphrases.bridgeZh: 本想做沙拉，却因加班赴约顾不上，菜放坏才发现买多了
locationParaphrases.note: 题干 arugula 原词出现在故事开头这一句。

locationParaphrases.sourceText: We waste food unintentionally at times.
locationParaphrases.targetText: I had unthinkingly bought way too much
locationParaphrases.note: 选项的“无意中”（unintentionally）就是原文的“不假思索地”（unthinkingly）；“有时”落在[[reading-b-1|Like most of us]]：作者平时也尽量留意（try to be mindful），这次还是浪费了。可见连有心节约的人也会不经意地浪费，选 B。

question:paper-gaokao-2022-i:25.questionFocus: 在文中找出食物浪费会带来什么后果。
question:paper-gaokao-2022-i:25.stemTranslationZh: 根据本文，食物浪费的一个后果是什么？

trap.relationNote: moral 出自[[reading-b-2]]罗伊特的话，说浪费食物有违道德（goes against the moral grain），这是对浪费的评价，不是说浪费让道德滑坡。

trapEvidence.quote: “food waste goes against the moral grain,”

evidence.quote: That makes food waste an environmental problem.
it would be the third largest producer of greenhouse gases in the world
evidence.anchor: 第三大温室气体排放者

trap.sourceQuote: Producing food that no one eats wastes the water, fuel, and other resources used to grow it.
trap.explanation: 原文只说生产没人吃的食物白白耗掉了水和燃料（fuel），没说因此造成能源短缺。

trapEvidence.quote: Producing food that no one eats wastes the water, fuel, and other resources used to grow it.

trap.sourceQuote: In a world where nearly 800 million people a year go hungry
trap.sourceEntity: nearly 800 million people a year go hungry
trap.explanation: 近8亿人挨饿（go hungry）是作者谈浪费时交代的背景，用来反衬浪费有违道德；原文没说挨饿是浪费造成的。

trapEvidence.quote: In a world where nearly 800 million people a year go hungry

locationParaphrases.targetText: That makes food waste an environmental problem.
locationParaphrases.note: 题干问浪费带来的后果，原文用 That makes food waste … 说浪费造成了什么。
选项的“环境危害”（Environmental harm）就是原文的“环境问题”（an environmental problem）；紧接着罗伊特还说浪费若是一个国家，就是第三大温室气体排放国（greenhouse gases），选 B。

trapEvidence.quote: Curtin is CEO of DC Central Kitchen in Washington, D.C., which recovers food and turns it into healthy meals.
